optional_dependencies.aapt: For APK analysis - apt install aapt
optional_dependencies.apktool: For APK decompilation - apt install apktool

help.description: Android penetration testing framework covering device fingerprinting, static/dynamic app analysis, vulnerability scanning, exploitation testing, network traffic interception, and forensics. Detects 50+ vulnerability types including SQL injection, insecure storage, cleartext traffic, exported components, and more. Includes automated exploitation chains for common Android vulnerabilities.

examples: recon              — Device fingerprint: root/bootloader/SELinux/patch-level/encryption
app_scan           — Static APK analysis: manifest, permissions, secrets, weak crypto, score
vuln_scan          — Device + app CVE assessment with NVD lookup
exploit            — Intent injection, SQLi on content providers, component abuse
network            — tcpdump capture + logcat credential leakage + proxy intercept
forensics          — DB/SharedPreferences extraction, logcat, SMS, ADB backup
full               — Runs recon → app_scan → vuln_scan → exploit → network → forensics
adb_wifi           — Enable ADB over TCP/WiFi (adb tcpip 5555)
get_root           — Multi-vector root: Magisk/su, adb root, CVE-2024-0044, mtk-su, KernelSU
exploit_cve        — Targeted CVE: CVE-2024-0044, CVE-2023-45866, CVE-2024-31317
cve_chain          — Chain multiple CVEs for privilege escalation path
zero_click         — Zero-interaction vectors: NFC record injection, BLE, WiFi
backdoor_apk       — Pull APK, inject msfvenom payload (-x template), sign, reinstall
deploy_shell       — Generate fresh msfvenom APK and install via adb
rebuild            — BootBuddy: boot persistence APK with WAN MSF C2 via bore tunnels
wan_expose         — Expose MSF + APK delivery via Cloudflare Tunnel, generate QR
qr_exploit         — QR payload: APK URL / Intent URI / ADB wireless pairing / deeplink
msf_handler        — Start Metasploit multi/handler with auto-generated RC file
frida_hook         — Deploy frida-server, SSL unpin, root bypass, dump creds, trace
objection_patch    — Embed Frida gadget via Objection (no root at runtime)
process_inject     — Inject payload into running process via /proc/mem or ptrace
lsposed_hook       — Generate + deploy LSPosed module hook (requires LSPosed)
persist            — Boot Receiver persistence without root (BOOT_COMPLETED)
inject_agent       — Push ARM64/shell agent, receive JSON recon + interactive C2
c2_gui             — Launch C2 web dashboard: sessions, bore, MSF, QR, agent callbacks
c2_cli             — Headless C2 server (no browser)
hook               — secV hook layer: monitor calls + C2 relay
unhook             — Remove secV hooks cleanly
bypass_play_protect— Repackage APK to evade Play Protect: rename, scrub, junk class, resign
customize_apk      — Patch icon (6 densities), label, applicationId of any APK
screen_mirror      — Live screen: ADB H.264/ffmpeg (15fps) or MSF screenshot polling
camera_snap        — Single camera frame via ADB intent screencap or MSF webcam_snap
camera_stream      — Live camera: ADB screencap loop (no payload) or MSF webcam_stream
mic_record         — Record mic: ADB tinycap chunks or MSF record_mic
speaker_push       — Push audio file to device and play; stop playback remotely
device_net_scan    — Scan device WiFi subnet via netrecon
full_pwn           — Auto-chain: recon→adb_wifi→get_root→device_net_scan→deploy_shell→persist→wan_expose
multi_device       — Run any sub-operation on ALL connected devices simultaneously
shell              — Reverse shell handler with auto-delivery via ADB
